The structure of U9Sb9N12 (reduced formula U3Sb3N4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mcm (No. 143), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows N centers coordinated by 3 U or 3 Sb neighbors, while Sb centers adopt 4- and 5-neighbor environments, and U centers are 10-coordinate with 4 N and 6 U neighbors. The neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal edge-sharing between N-centered 3-vertex polyhedra and corner-sharing between N and Sb polyhedra.
